data.title: Taxi boats to run along city canal
data.description: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with a taxi boat service on Klong Phasi Charoen, with electric and solar-hybrid boats planned for a route linking 15 piers.

data.title: Messi set for Argentina farewell in Benin friendly
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Lionel Messi was on Tuesday named in Argentina's squad for a friendly against Benin on October 6, a match that will serve as his farewell appearance after announcing his international retirement last month.

data.title: AI giants pursue self-regulation as safety fears mount
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The world's biggest AI companies are working on creating a standards body, ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said on Tuesday, as fears rise about the dangers of AI and pressure is on to create a safer version of the technology.

data.title: The Bernhard Langer I quite foolishly turned down
data.description: 'No, I can't', l said to a member, who had a 17-year-old Bernhard Langer standing next to him and who was asking if I would like to join them for a game. This reply will haunt me right up until l leave this planet, but at the time I was busy and the thought of playing with this scrawny anaemic-looking German kid was not too appealing.

data.title: Port aim to scalp Japanese giants Vissel in big ACL test
data.description: Port will have to be at their best when they face Vissel Kobe in the AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 today.

data.title: Negroni Week returns for its 14th edition
data.description: Campari, Italy’s iconic red apéritif, and Imbibe Magazine have announced the return of Negroni Week for its 14th edition, running globally from September 21-27.

data.title: Govt dunks on talk of MCOT-Thai PBS merger
data.description: Reports that loss-making MCOT Plc could merge with Thai PBS are unsubstantiated and no government directive has been issued, Minister Attached to the Prime Minister's Office Supamas Isarabhakdi said on Tuesday.

data.title: The architecture of belief
data.description: For nine years, filmmaker Sompot Chidgasornpongse carried the story of 9 Temples To Heaven with him. The basic idea remained unchanged -- a large family travels to nine temples in a single day to make merit for their grandmother, who has been warned that she may die before her birthday. But almost everything around that premise continued to evolve.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 16
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Dine out, change lives with Siam Piwat Group
data.description: Share the power of giving through food at "The Next Bucket: Save Lives & Change Lives", which is running until the end of this year.

data.title: Artists exit Sheeran tour in solidarity with Macklemore pro-Palestinian comments
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The artist Finneas and three other supporting acts announced they had quit British superstar Ed Sheeran's tour on Tuesday, after rapper Macklemore was dropped for making pro-Palestinian comments while performing.

data.title: Nat Yontararak debuts his Rabbit's Tale piano suite
data.description: OLive Music presents the world premiere of Rabbit's Tale piano suite, a neurodiverse-friendly performance by Nat Yontararak, at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.

data.title: Nintendo marks 40 years of Zelda with  Ocarina Of Time remake for Switch 2
data.description: In celebration of The Legend Of Zelda's 40th anniversary, a remake of the Ocarina Of Time instalment is launching on Nov 5 for the Nintendo Switch 2.

data.title: One Map plan to boost response
data.description: The government will develop a nationwide "One Map of Water" to create a shared database for monitoring floods and other water-related disasters and improve emergency response.

data.title: Buoyant spikers eye elusive volleyball gold
data.description: A little over two weeks after their Asian Championship victory and a historic first-ever Olympic qualification, the Thai women's volleyball team begin their quest for Asian Games glory on Wednesday.

data.title: Chalermcharn, Thatdao named flag bearers
data.description: Equestrian athlete Chalermcharn Yotviriyapanit and volleyball star Thatdao Nuekjang have been selected as the Thai flag bearers to lead the delegation into the stadium during the opening ceremony of the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on Saturday.

data.title: Cause for cheer in Thai PISA results
data.description: The Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says aggregate gains are encouraging, but the gap between the highest and lowest performers has yet to narrow.

data.title: Thais ready to roar in Aichi
data.description: Thailand's men's football team begin their 20th Asian Games campaign on Wednesday against Kyrgyzstan at the Toyota Stadium in Aichi, with coach Thawatchai Damrong-ongtrakul insisting his side can mount a serious challenge in a group that also features hosts Japan.

data.title: New centre to combat invasive fish
data.description: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has established a centre to coordinate efforts to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, calling the invasive species a national concern and promising visible results within three months.

data.title: Thailand launchpad for unbeaten Chen
data.description: Professional boxing can be expensive, especially for young fighters without major promotional backing. For developing professionals looking for regular activity and affordable training, Thailand have become an increasingly attractive option.

data.title: Data centre rules near completion
data.description: The government expects to finalise a framework and minimum standards for data centres within a month, focusing on preventing projects from affecting surrounding communities, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) secretary-general Danucha Pichayanan said on Tuesday.

data.title: ADB financing supports five hospitals nationwide
data.description: A public healthcare development project covering five hospitals nationwide will be funded by a US$211.9 million (6.87 billion baht) loan from the Asian Development Bank (ADB), backed by a total budget of 9.04 billion baht from 2026 to 2030.

data.title: Nation 'must act' as birth rate tumbles
data.description: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.

data.title: Cabinet backs national disaster insurance scheme
data.description: The cabinet has approved a national insurance scheme providing disaster coverage for about 30 million households from Oct 1, in a move aimed at speeding up compensation and cutting state relief costs.

data.title: EXAT advances 2-phase Phuket expressway project
data.description: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT) is pressing ahead with a 34.6-kilometre expressway network in Phuket to ease traffic congestion and support the province's urban and tourism growth.

data.title: Chadchart defends switch to electric rubbish trucks
data.description: City Hall has defended a plan to replace rented diesel rubbish trucks with electric vehicles, saying the switch could cut energy costs by about 4.75 billion baht, or 54%, over five years.

data.title: B95bn irrigation project gets nod
data.description: A six-year irrigation project worth 95 billion baht has been approved to improve flood management in the lower eastern Chao Phraya basin and protect communities and economic areas across eight provinces, including Bangkok, said the government.

data.title: New rules clarify emergency care rights
data.description: The cabinet has endorsed revised rules for the Universal Coverage for Emergency Patients (UCEP) scheme, reaffirming that critically ill emergency patients must receive treatment without being charged until they are out of danger, for up to 72 hours.

data.title: CIB uncovers ex-abbot's millions
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has uncovered more than 300 million baht in bank accounts linked to former Wat Phutthaisawan abbot Atichot Tanprasert and his close female associate as it widens its probe into suspected financial misconduct.
